title: Review of c52's third-trophic-level negative: on fresh seed 5 the top material added at t=4000 condenses into every prey body within ~800 t, the hunting predators vanish (no predator bodies from t~4800) and the population freezes into ~44 still three-layer composites to t=10000; persistent splits 4 vs 5 in the two-level twin (both generation 1)
summary: Labkit runs of world3.py with its defaults (nb3 2, kd3 400, mc -0.9; top material added at t=4000) on fresh seed 5, 128^2, 100 frames to T=10000, and the same world with top_on 0 (the two-level twin). w3/sheet.png: predators (orange) hunt prey (teal) at t=2600-4300; after t=4000 white top cores appear inside the prey, by t=4800 no predator body is left and from t~5200 to 10000 the ~44 composites sit still in a lattice. FACTS: 44 components at t=10000, 45 persistent tracks, 8 splits, 4 persistent splits, generation 1, 59 nucleations; inside top bodies the predator channel stays at ~0.21 of its range (core) against ~0.10 at the rim, and the top product s2 0.35. Two-level twin: 48 components, 27 persistent tracks, 34 splits, 5 persistent splits, generation 1, 84 nucleations.

observations.finding: w3/sheet.png t=4300-10000: top cores form in every prey body, predator bodies disappear by t~4800, and the composites stop moving and dividing; w3/FACTS.md: 4 persistent splits, generation 1, 45 persistent (still) tracks.

seeds_run.result: pass for the takeover and freeze: predators gone by t~4800, ~44 still composites to t=10000; the split contrast with the two-level twin is weaker than reported (4 vs 5 persistent splits here, 6-7 vs 17 in the author's seed 0)

not_checked: the other four parameter points (nb3 3/4, kd3 1500, mc -0.95)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and the default parameters only; at this seed the two-level twin itself divides little at 128^2 (5 persistent splits), so the 'third level stops reproduction' contrast rests mainly on the author's seed; the takeover and freeze of the predators reproduce clearly.
